contracts.idempotency_rules: Use trace_id plus source_record_id or request_id for repeat-safe processing.
contracts.official_name: ClientOps Support Issue to QA Change Request
contracts.persistence_expectations: Producer preserves source trace; consumer persists only if it owns authoritative state.
contracts.producer_behavior: Emit governed payload with evidence, traceability, and explicit readiness/limitation state.
contracts.purpose: Governed transition from ClientOps to QA + Delivery.
remaining_v1_work: No exact connection-matrix row; specification created as closure work.
contracts.retry_rules: Retry only idempotent reads/previews; mutation retries require idempotency key and audit record.
